message: v1.8.20: style(popup,companion): v1.8.20 restore tactile 3D button hover animation while preserving dark-mode contrast
changelog: CTA-Only 3D Button Offset Animation (src/popup/styles/11-design-marks.css, src/mobile/styles/09-onboarding-design.css): Scoped the Swiss tactile 3D offset hover/press animation exclusively to primary CTA buttons (.btn-scan-main, .btn-primary, .btn-primary-action, .btn-save-action) with crisp 0.12s response, keeping secondary, card-row, and icon buttons flat and instant in both the extension and companion while leaving the landing page unchanged.
